name: GetPdfPagesTextToListNode
label: Get Pdf Pages Text in List
description: Extracts text from each page of a Pdf file and returns a list of page texts.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: PdfFilePath
fields.label: Pdf File Path
fields.description: Full path to the Pdf file to extract text from (e.g., C:\docs\input.pdf).

fields.name: ListOfPages
fields.label: Page Texts
fields.description: List of strings, where each item contains the extracted text from one page.
